column1: # Pathogenic alleles that lab expression constructs and transgenic models
# carry, read by bin/clip_check.py (--construct) in step 06 and
# CLINVAR_CDNA_CHECK. A ClinVar hit at one of these sites gets a
# "known construct site" line with its cDNA read check counts, whatever the
# verdict: spliced cDNA or plasmid DNA in a library is called like a germline
# variant, and these are the alleles it most often brings (Kim 2020, Nature,
# PMID 32814883; Kim 2016, Bioinformatics, PMID 27334474). A real carrier is
# possible at every row (LRRK2 G2019S above all), so the line is a prompt to
# look at the reads, not a verdict.
# Positions are GRCh38 VCF positions; REF and ALT are ClinVar's alleles, from
# its canonical SPDI (E-utilities esummary, queried 2026-11-04; REF checked
# against UCSC hg38 the same day). clinvar_id is ClinVar's variation id.
# name is the allele as model and construct papers name it (legacy protein
# numbering: SOD1 G93A is p.Gly94Ala in HGVS, MAPT P301L is numbered on the
# 441-residue isoform).
